### CVE-2020-6418
- Assigner: Chrome | Published: 2020-02-27 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: Type confusion; CWE-843 CWE-843 Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 48186: Google Chrome 80 - JSCreate Side-effect Type Confusion (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2020-03-09, verified=1)

Type confusion in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 80.0.3987.122 allowed a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.

Affected:
- Google / Chrome: affected unspecified <80.0.3987.122 (custom)

### CVE-2020-7758 — Path Traversal
- Assigner: snyk | Published: 2020-11-02 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Path Traversal
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N/E:P/RL:O/RC:R`

This affects versions of package browserless-chrome before 1.40.2-chrome-stable. User input flowing from the workspace endpoint gets used to create a file path filePath and this is fetched and then sent back to a user. This can be escaped to fetch arbitrary files from a server.

Affected:
- n/a / browserless-chrome: affected before 1.40.2-chrome-stable

Credits: Snyk Security Team

References:
- https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JS-BROWSERLESSCHROME-1023657 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/browserless/chrome/blob/master/src/routes.ts%23L175 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/browserless/chrome/commit/848b87e5bea4f8473eea85261a5ff922d6ebd2b6 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/browserless/chrome/releases/tag/1.40.2-chrome-stable [x_refsource_MISC]
